item.name: Get the list of all accessible Workspaces

request.name: Get the list of all accessible Workspaces

description.content: Lists all accessible Workspaces.

query.description: If true (reserved to admin users), returns all existing workspaces, including the workspaces I am not member of. If false, returns only the workspaces I am a member of.
The maximum number of elements returned by this call. The maximum must be less than or equal to 200.
The offset of the first element to return. Starting at this offset, the query will return a maximum of 'limit' elements.
